visual.general_description: Close-up color photograph of an eye with a central grayish-white opacity in the pupillary area.
visual.detailed_description: Close-up color photograph of one eye under diffuse illumination. Upper and lower eyelid skin and lashes frame the view, a brown iris surrounds a dark pupillary zone, and within it lies a roughly oval, grayish-white opacity with a fine granular, dust-like texture and slightly paler rim. A small bright white light reflection sits at the lower left of the opacity and a bright glare covers the upper left corner of the image. No text, arrows, scale or panel letters are visible.
